title: Reduce CI cost without hiding behavioral results
scope: Separate governance/document signal from behavioral test signal, add a strict evidence/state-only verification scope, and preserve fail-closed full verification for executable, schema, workflow, package, test, unknown, rename, deletion, or mode changes.
acceptance_criteria: A governance failure remains release-blocking but does not prevent the behavioral lane from producing its result; job summary reports both outcomes and the chosen scope.

Strict evidence/state-only changes run repository checks, fast contracts, schema, Doctor, and focused evidence/status verification without all integration tests; adversarial scope tests prove unsafe or ambiguous changes select full verification.
